Diversity includes stable traits like cognitive ability and personality, which are relatively constant, and dynamic traits like attitudes and emotions, which can change. Personality tests are used to predict job performance by assessing traits such as extraversion and conscientiousness. Five distortions in perceptions, including implicit bias and self-fulfilling prophecies, impact organizational behavior. Emotional intelligence, comprising personal and social competence, can be developed over time.
